videos.text:
Dad, I think I don't like Tiki-Tiki anymore. Capiche?
Honey, you can always listen to Tiki-Tiki slowed or Tiki-Tiki sped up instead.
No! I don't want Tiki-Tiki slowed and I don't want Tiki-Tiki sped up either. I'm sick of Tiki-Tiki!
Tung Junior, what has gotten into you?
Tung-Tung-Sahur Junior! Nobody speaks badly about Tiki-Tiki in this house! You're grounded for the rest of your life!
Oh, my goodness!
I don't know why father got so angry.
But he won't decide my future.
Mom, dad,
I'm sorry, but I have to do this.
Dictator Yara-Yara Tom, we have detained this child. He tried to secretly enter the Sponge-Funk laboratory. He might be a spy from the Tiki-Tiki Republic.
No, I'm not a spy!
I'm done with Tiki-Tiki!
I want Yara-Yara!
All right, let him go.
I'll take care of this.
Here we develop new Sponge-Funks for the fight against Tiki-Tiki.
And can I really become Yara-Yara too?
Well, there is a way, but it's very risky.
I want to try.
You know what to do.
Yes, sir!
What? What is that?
What's going on?
I'd better check it out myself.
Oh man.
Is this kid empty in the head or?
So?
Where do I find Tiki-Tiki now?
Oh man.
That doesn't look good at all.
So you think you can defeat Tiki-Tiki?
I will rule the entire world!
Not if I stop you.
Then try it!
Ryōiki Tenkai.
Ryōiki Tenkai.
I admit, you're strong Yara-Yara Tom.
But that wasn't my full power.
You don't know when to stop, do you?
Fine.
Bring it on!
Ryōiki Tenkai.
Malevolent Tiki-Tiki.
Ryōiki Tenkai.
Infinite Yara-Yara.
